data.title: Address Residences The Bay
data.about:
Address Residence – The Bay is a prestigious waterfront development by Emaar, located in the heart of Emaar Beachfront. Blending the signature elegance of Address Hotels + Resorts with the tranquility of seaside living, this exclusive project features branded 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, spacious penthouses, and limited 3-bedroom townhouses. Set against a backdrop of crystal-clear waters and pristine private sands, it offers residents an unmatched urban island lifestyle. From breathtaking marina views to uninterrupted access to 1.5 kilometers of private beach, every aspect of the project is crafted for those who appreciate refined luxury and effortless convenience.

Just steps away from the Marina & Yacht Club and only 5 minutes from Dubai Marina, Address Residence – The Bay also offers direct connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road, making daily commutes seamless. Residents enjoy a resort-style experience with beach pools, fully equipped hotel gym access, kids’ play areas, gourmet dining, BBQ zones, and 5-star hotel amenities. Whether you’re looking for a serene primary residence or a high-yield investment, Address The Bay sets a new standard for beachfront living in Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Address Residences The Bay: Iconic Branded Living by the Beach
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Iconic Waterfront Location: Address Residences The Bay is nestled along the pristine shores of Emaar Beachfront, offering uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf and direct beach access.
  • Branded Luxury Residences by Address Hotels + Resorts: Choose from 1, 2 & 3-bedroom apartments, 3 & 4-bedroom penthouses, and 3-bedroom townhouses, all designed to world-class standards by the renowned Address brand.
  • Resort-Style Living Redefined: At Address Residences The Bay, enjoy exclusive amenities like a beach pool, kids’ play area, hotel-grade gym, BBQ zones, and a landscaped community park.
  • Exclusive Lifestyle Privileges: Residents of Address Residences The Bay benefit from 5-star hotel services, exclusive discounts at Address Hotel – The Bay, and access to premium hospitality facilities.
  • Unmatched Connectivity: Ideally located with direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road, just 5 minutesfrom Dubai Marina, and footsteps from the Marina & Yacht Club.
  • Private Island Living at Dubai Harbour: This gated beachfront community by Emaar offers privacy, security, and proximity to Dubai’s finest malls, yacht clubs, and gourmet destinations.

location_tile.title: Setting News Standards of Luxury Living
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Address Residences – The Bay enjoys a prime location within Emaar Beachfront, set along the tranquil shores of Dubai Harbour. Perfectly positioned between Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina, the development offers direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road, ensuring seamless connectivity to the rest of the city. Surrounded by luxury retail, gourmet dining, and world-class yacht clubs, this iconic beachfront address blends the serenity of island living with the energy of Dubai’s most sought-after destinations.

  • 5 minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 5 minutes to Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 10 minutes to Palm Jumeirah
